verdict.rationale: Sketch's core design tool is a native Mac app that runs on the user's own machine. It works on open, locally stored .sketch files (zipped JSON), includes a local-only MCP server and the sketchtool CLI, and community reports say licenses keep working without being renewed. However, the Workspace and web app used for inspection, collaboration and handoff are vendor-hosted, and nothing in the evidence shows they can be self-hosted. One community report also notes that old licensed versions may stop working on newer macOS. Missing for 10: self-hostable Workspace/web-app server, documented on-prem or private deployment option, and support for running on non-Mac infrastructure.
